mr_title: perf(material/tooltip): Defer injection of injectables not needed until tooltip is shown.

expected_issues.title: Lazy ViewContainerRef injection breaks tooltip hydration
expected_issues.description:
Deferring ViewContainerRef injection until the first tooltip display changes the view-container structure after component creation. During hydration, a tooltip can then fail on first hover because the client materializes a container that was not established in the corresponding server-rendered view.

The linked upstream correction explicitly restores eager ViewContainerRef injection for hydration. Keep this dependency eager while deferring other services. Comment anchors do not count as CSS element siblings, so :last-child and ordinary sibling selectors are not valid examples of this defect.
